summary: Rule 2b (line 285-291) is unreachable. _classify_input() returns THINK_PREPARATION for any input with think=True (line 165), so input_type is never USER_QUERY when think=True — the Rule 2b conjunction can never be satisfied. Both Rule 2a and the dead Rule 2b route to RouteType.THINK, so there is no current functional regression, but the dead branch hides a design ambiguity: THINK_PREPARATION (explicit prep intent) and USER_QUERY+think=True (query that needs thinking) are collapsed to the same input type with no way to distinguish them at the routing layer.
